id.description: Primary key for this delivery row.

temporal_workflow_id.description: Temporal workflow id for this delivery run.

idempotency_key.description: Dedupes activity retries for the same logical run.

trigger_type.description: Why the run started (e.g. scheduled, manual, target_change).

target_type.description: Channel snapshot at send time (email, slack, webhook).

target_value.description: Destination snapshot at send time (emails, channel id, URL).

exported_asset_ids.description: ExportedAsset ids generated for this send.

content_snapshot.description: Snapshot at send time: dashboard metadata, total_insight_count, and per-exported-insight entries (id, short_id, name, query_hash, cache_key, query_results, optional query_error).

recipient_results.description: Per-destination outcomes; items use status success, failed, or partial.

status.description:
Overall run status: starting, completed, failed, or skipped.

* `starting` - Starting
* `completed` - Completed
* `failed` - Failed
* `skipped` - Skipped

error.description: Top-level failure payload when status is failed, if any.

created_at.description: When the delivery row was created.

last_updated_at.description: Last ORM update to this row.

finished_at.description: When the run finished, if applicable.

change_summary.description: AI-generated summary included in this delivery, when one was produced.
